rationale: The last 5 one-minute candles show a clear short-term momentum shift downward — price dropped from ~$14.26 to $14.14 with the most recent candle showing very thin volume (502 shares), suggesting the move may be stalling but direction is unclear. The stock is already up 8% on the gap with no news catalyst identified, sitting at 83.5% of today's range near the high, which creates risk in both directions: chasing long risks a mean-reversion pullback, while shorting a high-relative-volume gap-up with strong market conditions (SPY +0.60%, VIXY -0.41%) is also dangerous. With two working orders already consuming ~5.8% of buying power and insufficient edge to commit to either direction, skipping is the prudent choice.
